notes.title: VR Hands and Oculus Support Added
notes.notes:
Just as the title says, finally added the much asked for support for both controllers. You can now pick up items you see lying around.
Grab them from your inventory and throw them to a friend.
I have also added support to play the game with the Rift and Rift S.

[previewyoutube=UCkxBjjsxq8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Multiplayer co-op has received some improvements
notes.notes:
Hey all, just wanted to let you know that the co-op mode now supports save games and in addition, there's a new twist. When you or your friend dies, they come back as a zombie to make life harder for the living!

This update also makes the game playable with all mobile versions of the game.

notes.title: Multiplayer Has Been Added!
notes.notes:
At long last, I am happy to announce that the game now support a multiplayer co-op mode! You can access the new content through the first main menu room. 
The co-op mode feature all the areas of the base game, and now all of the weapons and monsters will be randomly placed when spawning! So enjoy! I was looking to create a bit of co-op RE style VR game.

The multiplayer is fully compatible with the Windows and Linux versions of the game although only some of the maps are compatible with the mobile players (Oculus Go, Daydream and such). If this is something you'd like let me know!, I could make that happen.

notes.title: Game has been made more difficult!
notes.notes: Ok guys, look out, I made the game a bit more difficult. Y'all we're getting through it tot easy. I won't quite say what all has been changed, but if you played it at release, expect it to be a little more challenging now!
